data.gender_notes: Tejal is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Tejal is a Sanskrit and Hindi name for girls which means radiant, shining, auspicious. The name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'tejas' which means radiance or brightness. It is also associated with the goddess Tejaswini, who is known as the goddess of purity, grace, and knowledge. The name Tejal carries the meaning “Radiant, Shining, Auspicious” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Tejal usually hope their child will grow to embody radiant, shining, auspicious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Tejal is a spiritual name with deep meaning and significance. It represents the inner radiance and light that shines within every individual. It is a reminder to keep our inner light shining bright and to share it with the world. It is also a symbol of grace, purity, and knowledge.
data.etymology: Tejal belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Radiant, Shining, Auspicious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Tejal total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: The name Tejal signifies an auspicious and shining personality. It is often given to a girl to bless her with a radiant and bright future. In many Hindu communities, it is considered significant to choose a meaningful and auspicious name for a child.
data.spiritual_significance: Tejal is deeply connected to the spiritual world. The name is derived from Tejas, which symbolizes inner radiance and brightness. The goddess Tejaswini embodies this spiritual quality and is revered as a symbol of purity, grace, and knowledge. Thus, bearing the name Tejal is a reminder for every individual to strive towards inner radiance and spiritual growth.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Tejal means 'Radiant' or 'Shining'. This name symbolizes the inner light and strength that illuminates one's path and inspires confidence. It represents the divine energy that empowers an individual to overcome challenges and shine brightly.

historical_references.reference: Tejal was an Apsara or celestial nymph who was one of the twelve Aditya Kumaris. She was the goddess of radiance, beauty, and grace. She was the consort of Aditya, the Sun God, and is said to have been born from the tears of Sage Vashista when he wept for the death of his son, the Moon God's son Andhaka.
Tejasi (Tejal) was a queen in the Satavahana Dynasty of ancient India, who ruled between 120 CE and 130 CE. She is known for her patronage of Buddhism, and her coins bear the image of the Buddha.
